# Newsworthy

> A calm global status indicator: a number out of 10 and one sentence explaining why.

Newsworthy helps people stay connected to the world without constant anxious
news consumption or switching off entirely. Check in, then get on with your day.

No doomscrolling. No subscription. No in-app purchases. No ads. No engagement,
addiction or growth-hacking tactics.

## Product facts

- An AI model assesses public news. Higher scores mean more consequential news;
  the displayed score fades as developments age.
- Ratings update periodically and can be wrong. Newsworthy is not an
  emergency-alert service or a complete account of events.
- The last reading is saved locally for connection failures, with its original
  update time. A saved reading is not necessarily current.
- The web app is available now. iOS and Android apps and home-screen widgets
  are in preparation; no app-store availability is claimed.
- The planned mobile store release is a one-time US$1 download, with local store
  equivalents, to help offset running costs. Store pricing is not yet confirmed.
- The shared web and mobile interface uses Expo / React Native. Admin views are web-only.
- Contact: astrojams1@gmail.com.

## Public links

- [Web app](https://newsworthy-indol.vercel.app/): The latest displayed rating.
- [Privacy](https://newsworthy-indol.vercel.app/privacy): Storage, technical information and support messages.
- [Support](https://newsworthy-indol.vercel.app/support): Help and contact information.
- [Current rating API](https://newsworthy-indol.vercel.app/api/current): Public read-only JSON.

## Authorized rating agents

- [Caller API schema](https://newsworthy-indol.vercel.app/api/openapi.json): Authentication and submission contract.
- [Caller instructions](https://newsworthy-indol.vercel.app/api/instructions): Requires a caller token; contains the current prompt and workflow.

This page describes the product. It is not the rating prompt and does not
change the rating scale. Authorized rating agents fetch current instructions
each run and follow their prompt-integrity and submission contract. No tokens
or credentials are published here.
